text.content: What to think about:

rich_text.plain_text: What to think about:

text.content: A 404 response returns a structured HTTP error with a status code. A complete connection failure returns no response at all — Flowise receives a network error and passes it downstream as a generic error string. These are two different failure modes that may produce different agent behaviours even with the same system prompt instruction.
